description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LuxuryAirplane" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/luxury-airplane">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerSpecifications" name="Customer specifications"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Requirements" name="Manufacturing requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsDelivered" name="Interior parts delivered"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Manufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer" processRef="Process_AirplaneManufacturer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_PartnerTeams" name="Partner Manufacturing Teams"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Specifications" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Requirements" name="Requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="Participant_PartnerTeams"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsDelivered" name="Parts" sourceRef="Participant_PartnerTeams" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_TestProtocol" name="Test protocol" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="Participant_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DeliveryConfirmation" name="Delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_AirplaneManufacturer" name="Airplane Manufacturer Process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" name="Customer specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Specifications" messageRef="Message_CustomerSpecifications"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordSpecifications" name="Record customer specifications (bars, seats, color, toilet water, additional options)"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to partner teams" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsReceived" name="Interior parts received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_PartsReceived" messageRef="Message_PartsDelivered"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble plane interior"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ConductTestFlight" name="Conduct test flight"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateTestProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" name="Send test protocol to manufacturer and customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Customer confirms delivery">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DeliveryConfirmed" messageRef="Message_DeliveryConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" name="Delivery confirmed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordSpecifications"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_2" sourceRef="Task_RecordSpecifications" targetRef="SendTask_SendRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_3" sourceRef="SendTask_SendRequirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_4" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_PartsReceived" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_5" sourceRef="Task_AssembleInterior" targetRef="Task_ConductTestFlight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_6" sourceRef="Task_ConductTestFlight" targetRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_7" sourceRef="Task_CreateTestProtocol" targetRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_8" sourceRef="SendTask_SendTestProtocol" targetRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_9" sourceRef="ManualTask_DeliverAirplane" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="SequenceFlow_10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_DeliveryConfirmed" targetRef="EndEvent_DeliveryConfirmed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_PartnerTeams" name="Partner Manufacturing Teams" isExecutable="false"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
